Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of all topics covered in this module — including AI-generated presentations, slide deck generation, narration options, speaker notes, text-to-speech conversion, and audio embedding — used by learners and instructors to navigate and preview the module's scope.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to AI-Generated Presentations
Artifacts.Description: An introductory reading that explains what AI-generated presentations are, how PreseMaker's Module Editor uses existing module topics to automate slide creation, and why this approach reduces the manual effort traditionally required in instructional design.

Artifacts.Name: Generating a PowerPoint Slide Deck from Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A reading that walks learners through how to access and use the Module Editor's AI-driven slide deck generator, explaining how existing module topics are mapped to individual slides and how to initiate the automated PowerPoint generation process.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding the Narrated Presentation Option
Artifacts.Description: A reading that distinguishes between standard and narrated presentation outputs in PreseMaker, describing the technical pipeline behind narrated presentations and helping learners decide which output type suits their instructional needs.

Artifacts.Name: Writing Per-Slide Speaker Notes
Artifacts.Description: A reading focused on writing effective per-slide speaker notes within PreseMaker, explaining that these notes serve as the actual script for text-to-speech audio and guiding learners on how to draft, refine, and align notes with slide visuals.

Artifacts.Name: Converting Speaker Notes to Spoken Audio with Text-to-Speech
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how PreseMaker's text-to-speech engine converts written speaker notes into synthesized spoken audio for each slide, covering the conversion process and how it eliminates the need for manual voice recording.

Artifacts.Name: Embedding Audio and Timing into Slides
Artifacts.Description: A reading describing how PreseMaker embeds TTS-generated audio clips into the PowerPoint file and synchronises each clip with its corresponding slide, including how slide timing is set so the presentation advances automatically with the narration.

Artifacts.Name: Embedding Audio and Timing into Slides
Artifacts.Description: A reading describing how PreseMaker embeds TTS-generated audio clips into the PowerPoint file and synchronises each clip with its corresponding slide, including how slide timing is set so the presentation advances automatically with the narration.
